title: Funeral Home Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate the services or resources of funeral homes. Includes activities such as determining prices for services or merchandise and managing the facilities of funeral homes.

tasks.text: Consult with families or friends of the deceased to arrange funeral details, such as obituary notice wording, casket selection, or plans for services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Technical advice needs product-specific human judgment

dwas.name: Advise customers on technical or procedural issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Schedule funerals, burials, or cremations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI arranges schedules; human manages real-world changes

dwas.name: Schedule activities or facility use.

tasks.text: Deliver death certificates to medical facilities or offices to obtain signatures from legally authorized persons.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Complete program documentation from inputs

dwas.name: Deliver items.

Coordinate regulatory documentation activities.

dwas.name: Implement organizational process or policy changes.
Develop operating strategies, plans, or procedures.

dwas.name: Resolve customer complaints or problems.

Analyze financial records to improve efficiency.
